title: Why Volcanoes Make Their Own Lightning
description: Some eruptions light up with lightning inside the ash cloud. It's called a dirty thunderstorm, and it starts with billions of tiny collisions.
comment: Would you want to see an eruption up close?

scenes.narration: Sometimes a volcano erupts, and lightning flashes right inside the ash cloud.
As ash, rock and ice blast upward, the particles crash into each other.
Every collision swaps a little electric charge. Light grains rise high, heavy ones stay low, and the cloud splits into charged layers.
When the difference grows big enough, it snaps back as lightning.
A volcano building its own storm, from nothing but rock and ice.
